findings.condition: gateway.create() throws (simulated response loss) and markUnknown() runs
findings.impact: markUnknown() sets rental_payment_attempts.updated_at using raw SQL clock_timestamp() instead of the injectable inventory_clock() used by every other state transition in this service (this.time(c)). Under a controlled/mocked test clock (as used throughout tests/flow/fixture.ts's x.clock()), this one column silently uses real wall-clock time while every other timestamp in the same row/booking uses the mocked domain clock, producing an audit-trail inconsistency that is invisible to current assertions (updated_at is not compared in any test) but would corrupt any future reconciliation logic that trusts updated_at as domain time.
findings.evidence: packages/core/src/payment/booking-service.ts line 32: `await c.query("UPDATE rental_payment_attempts SET state='UNKNOWN',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND state='SUBMITTING'",[attemptId]);` versus every other transition (e.g. recordObservation) which passes the mocked `now` parameter explicitly to `updated_at`.
findings.fix: Thread `now` (from this.time(c) inside the transaction) into the UPDATE instead of calling clock_timestamp() directly, matching the pattern used elsewhere in this file.
findings.test: Add an assertion in tests/flow/payment.ts's UNKNOWN-response-loss case comparing rental_payment_attempts.updated_at to the fixture's mocked x.now(), which would currently fail.

findings.condition: A future authorized writer role is granted INSERT on rental_receipts before this constraint is added
findings.impact: rental_receipts only enforces `CHECK(actual_received_at<=confirmed_at)` at the database level; it does not enforce `scanned_at<=actual_received_at` or `scanned_at<=confirmed_at`, even though the pure contract in packages/contracts/src/return-cycle.ts (receiptDisposition) enforces exactly that ordering in application code. Since no application role currently has write access to this table (confirmed absent from scripts/flow-roles.ts and scripts/application-roles.ts), this is not presently exploitable, but if a future E12 writer bypasses or has a bug in the application-layer check, the database has no independent safety net for this specific ordering invariant, unlike the actual_received_at<=confirmed_at case which IS enforced twice.
findings.evidence: packages/db/migrations/0010_rental_custody.sql line 15: `CREATE TABLE rental_receipts(...scanned_at timestamptz NOT NULL,confirmed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,actual_received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,CHECK(actual_received_at<=confirmed_at));` contains only one of the three pairwise ordering checks that packages/contracts/src/return-cycle.ts's receiptDisposition() validates.
findings.fix: Add `CHECK(scanned_at<=actual_received_at AND scanned_at<=confirmed_at)` to the rental_receipts table before any role is granted write access to it, as a required activation prerequisite alongside the FLOW_DEV_BLOCKED_PERMISSIONS.md owner decision.
findings.test: A future integration test inserting a rental_receipts row with scanned_at after actual_received_at should fail at the database level even if application validation is bypassed; no such test currently exists because the table is unconnected.

insufficient_evidence: docs/execution/AUDIT_AG_STATUS.json is listed as modified in the file-status diff but its content/diff was not included in the supplied snapshot, so the claimed reconciliation of prior A-G status against this new delegation could not be verified.

docs/execution/evidence/flow-dev/flow-booking-desktop.png and flow-booking-mobile-width.png are referenced screenshot artifacts; binary image content was not inspectable, so the mobile/desktop UI rendering claims rest only on the accompanying code-level scrollWidth<=innerWidth assertion in tests/flow/normal-ui.ts, not visual confirmation.

ADR 0017's explicit claim that a process restart between a successful gateway.create() and DB persistence 'stays incomplete and never creates another request' is asserted in prose but no test in tests/flow/payment.ts exercises an actual process/module restart with the FakeGateway's in-memory receipts map cleared; only the in-process failAfterSave path (gateway.create() itself throwing) is tested, which is a materially different failure mode than persistence failing after a successful gateway call.

packages/db/src/schema.ts (drizzle schema definitions) was not included in the snapshot and is not listed as modified; its consistency with the new rental_* raw-SQL tables could not be directly confirmed, though the codebase's established pattern of using raw pg queries (not drizzle) for all domain tables makes drift unlikely.

No independent test execution was performed by this review; all pass/fail evidence (payment-18.log, ui-5.log, return-cycle-after.log, CI run 34700107256) is taken as supplied and cross-checked only for internal logical consistency against the code, not re-run.
activation_prerequisites: Owner decision on the three items in docs/execution/FLOW_DEV_BLOCKED_PERMISSIONS.md (custody-table writer role, RENTAL_CHECKOUT/RENTAL_RETURN exposure in StaffManagement UI, narrow actual-receipt operation) before any E12 loan/return database write path can exist.
Addition of the missing scanned_at ordering CHECK constraints on rental_receipts (F2) before any role is granted INSERT/UPDATE on the E12 custody tables.

Real Square Sandbox credentials and an authorized external webhook endpoint before E10's 'Actual Square transport/Sandbox/external callback' gap can be closed; explicitly BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED per this delegation.
Physical smartphone/camera verification before any claim of a working continuous-scan return UI, which does not exist in this PR (E12 has no camera/return UI at all, by design).
scope_assessment: This review examined the E10 payment core (packages/core/src/payment/booking-service.ts, square-boundary.ts, packages/contracts/src/rental-flow.ts, migrations 0009/0010, scripts/flow-roles.ts), the E11 customer/staff booking preview (apps/web BookingWorkspace.tsx, preview/rental route, booking-http.ts, the RecommendationWorkspace.tsx one-line quote-preview link addition), and the E12 unconnected artifacts (packages/contracts/src/return-cycle.ts pure contract, migration 0010 custody schema, and confirmation that no application role in flow-roles.ts or application-roles.ts has any grant on the new custody tables/views, i.e. E12 is genuinely inert as claimed, not merely undocumented). The hold-service.ts change in this delta is a structural extraction of existing PR9 allocation logic into packages/core/src/inventory/allocation.ts, plus one narrow, intentional, test-covered behavioral addition (allowing a CONFIRMED_DEV/SUCCESS+confirmed_at hold to participate in replanning) required for the 'confirmed provisional witness remains flexible' E10 feature; this was traced line-by-line against the diff and found behaviorally faithful except for that documented addition. Payment identity persistence-before-side-effects, UNKNOWN/no-replacement-charge, signature verification/dedup/out-of-order/terminal-contradiction handling, exact price/currency/merchant/location/reference/capture-time matching, HOLD-expiry and full-claim protection at confirmation, auth-before-and-after-lock-wait ordering, creator-vs-scoped-reader separation, and the inability of the normal production route to enable simulation via env/body/cookie were all verified directly against code (not merely against test names) and found consistent with the stated contract. Prior PR9 A-G files not touched by this delta (ledger-service, transfer, quote-service core logic, staff-auth resolution, existing hold intake/period-matching) were not re-reviewed, per instruction. The full E10-E13 rental/return loop (real Sandbox, continuous-scan return UI, real custody reintegration) remains explicitly incomplete and blocked on an owner permission decision; this status is preserved as a blocker independent of the REVIEW_PASS verdict on the submitted, implemented subset, and is not contradicted by any finding in this review.
